WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(HGB) as overall_hgb_avg
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
),
patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as patient_hgb_avg
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
),
above_average_patients AS (
  SELECT pa.ID, pa.patient_hgb_avg
  FROM patient_avgs pa, overall_avg oa
  WHERE pa.patient_hgb_avg > oa.overall_hgb_avg
),
above_avg_patients_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(patient_hgb_avg) as avg_of_above_avg_patients
  FROM above_average_patients
)
SELECT 
  aap.ID,
  aap.patient_hgb_avg,
  aap.patient_hgb_avg - (SELECT overall_hgb_avg FROM overall_avg) as above_overall_avg,
  aap.patient_hgb_avg - (SELECT avg_of_above_avg_patients FROM above_avg_patients_avg) as above_above_avg_patients_avg
FROM above_average_patients aap
ORDER BY above_above_avg_patients_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
